name: zclass_camera_render_overlay_nodes
description: zClass_Camera::RenderOverlayNodes resets the clip mask and dispatches overlay child nodes.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this overlay helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent camera source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44d200 validates writing 0x3f through gModel_ClipMaskStackTop, iterating world->listB up to world->listCountB, and dispatching each child through zClass_Class::gwNodeRenderDispatch with sibling count hint 2.
The native overlay-node smoke verifies clip-mask reset to 0x3f and dispatch of two overlay nodes in list order.
